home.subject: Your walls are talking. What are they saying?
home.hero_alt: Bold abstract canvas art in a modern living room
home.headline: Every space tells a story. What’s yours saying?
home.body_line_1: You think about lighting. Layout. The throw pillows, the rug, the shelf styling. Every detail in your home signals something about who you are. But what about the walls?
home.body_line_2: Most people leave them blank—or worse, forgettable. A room with the right art doesn’t just look better. It feels different. You linger longer. You breathe deeper. You actually want to be there.
home.vp1_body: Every piece is created by artist Kingler Bercy. No stock art. No prints you’ve seen in a thousand living rooms. Work that makes people stop scrolling and start staring.
home.vp2_body: Abstract and geometric compositions that create atmosphere—whether that’s a calm bedroom, an energized home office, or a living room that finally feels finished.
home.vp3_body: Museum-quality canvas, printed and shipped from Montreal. Sizes from 12×16 to 53×72—a nightstand accent or an entire statement wall. Your space, your scale.

designer.body_line_2: Too many projects default to safe, forgettable prints sourced from the same three catalogs. Your work deserves better. Original artwork turns a beautiful room into an unforgettable one.

restaurant.body_line_2: The best restaurants and bars don’t decorate. They curate. A single bold piece creates a focal point that guests remember, photograph, and tag. Your art becomes part of your brand.

office.subject: Blank walls say more than you think.
office.hero_alt: Three original artworks in a modern office space
office.headline: Blank walls say more than you think.
office.body_line_1: Your office signals your culture before anyone opens their mouth. The furniture, the layout, the light—every detail tells a story about who you are as a company. But blank walls? They say: we didn’t think about it.
office.body_line_2: The companies people want to work for—and work with—invest in the details. Original artwork in a lobby or conference room doesn’t just look good. It says: we pay attention.
office.vp1_body: Geometric and minimalist work that communicates sophistication without distraction. Art that elevates a space without competing with the work happening in it.
office.vp2_body: Lobbies, conference rooms, corridors, common areas. Cohesive collections that work across your entire space—not one random piece per floor.
office.vp3_title: Art that says ‘we pay attention to details.’
office.vp3_body: Clients notice. Candidates notice. Every visitor forms an impression. Original art from a single artist tells a more intentional story than generic corporate prints.
